description: This Java source file defines the final class DefaultUserInformation which implements the UserInformation interface. It encapsulates user-related information such as default subject and a list of subjects. The class includes methods for creating instances from an AuthorizationContext or JSON object, as well as serialization, equality, and string representation methods.

classes.name: DefaultUserInformation
classes.description: Immutable implementation of UserInformation that holds user subjects and default subject, with methods for creation from context or JSON, and serialization.

methods.name: fromAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Creates a DefaultUserInformation instance from an AuthorizationContext object, extracting the first authorization subject and all authorization subjects.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a DefaultUserInformation object from a given JsonObject, extracting default subject and subjects list.

methods.name: getDefaultSubject
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the default subject if available.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of subjects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JsonObject, with optional filtering via predicate.
